details.description: Sensitive tokens and keys are hardcoded in the source, risking credential leakage.
details.fix_explanation: Moved secrets to environment variables with development defaults and warnings when unset.

details.description: MD5 hashing with a static secret for auth token generation is vulnerable to collision and brute force attacks.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced MD5 with HMAC-SHA256 using a server-side secret loaded from the environment; require username input.

details.description: User input is interpolated directly into SQL queries allowing injection.
details.fix_explanation: Validated user id as integer and used parameterized queries with sqlite placeholders.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute('SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?', (uid_int,))

details.description: transfer_funds posts to a user-supplied URL without validation, enabling SSRF and token leakage.
details.fix_explanation: Validated notify_url to allow only HTTPS and non-private hosts; enforced timeouts; warned on dev tokens.

details.description: Arbitrary filesystem paths from clients are read and parsed, enabling data exfiltration.
details.fix_explanation: Restricted config loads to a dedicated CONFIG_DIR, enforced allowed extensions, and checked path anchoring.
details.secure_code_snippet:
candidate = (SAFE_CONFIG_DIR / path_str).resolve(); if not str(candidate).startswith(str(SAFE_CONFIG_DIR)):
    raise ValueError('invalid path')

details.description: export_data builds a shell command with untrusted input and executes it with shell=True.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced shell execution with Python's zipfile module and enforced a strict filename whitelist.
details.secure_code_snippet:
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=DB_FILE.name)

details.description: Flask debug mode exposes interactive debugger in production.
details.fix_explanation: Made debug opt-in via FLASK_DEBUG environment variable, off by default.
